("Bluesky" or the "Company") announces that, further to its news release of October 19, 2026, Mr. Frank Kordy has departed the Company as a Director. A replacement to fill the vacancy left by Mr. Kordy has not yet been named. The Company is actively evaluating its board composition to ensure it continues to support its strategic goals and will provide a further update once available.

Bluesky Digital Assets Corp. is creating a digital enterprise at the intersection of Artificial Intelligence, Blockchain and Web3 business solutions. Leveraging its success as an early adopter providing proprietary technology solutions, Bluesky has invested in its Roadmap.
